results: 1. levodopa trial: no response - not dopa-responsive dystonia
3. dystonia gene panel: pathogenic THAP1 variant c.505C>T (p.Arg169*), heterozygous - DYT6
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: THAP1-associated primary generalized dystonia (DYT6), caused by a heterozygous pathogenic THAP1 c.505C>T (p.Arg169*) variant, with cranial/laryngeal involvement causing spasmodic dysarthria.

Alternative: TOR1A-associated dystonia (DYT1)

Alternative: Functional neurological disorder with dystonia

Alternative: Dopa-responsive dystonia (GCH1-associated)
